title: ranunculus pedatifidus var. cardiophyllus
intro: Ranunculus pedatifidus var. cardiophyllus, commonly known as Heart-Leaf Buttercup, is a variety of the Ranunculus plant species. It is known for its heart-shaped leaves and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is said to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus pedatifidus var. cardiophyllus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties.
